items.title: Jonathan Bailey's breathy Dracula audiobook clip sends fans feral
items.summary: Entertainment Tonight shared a behind-the-scenes clip of Jonathan Bailey and Ella Purnell recording a feeding scene for Audible's new Bram Stoker's Dracula, with heavy breathing, a hand on his chest and Purnell biting an apple for the sound effect. The clip split viewers between thirst and second-hand embarrassment, and posts asking whether audiobooks were their new kink spread across X and TikTok.
